title: NuNet: Cardano supported SSI/DID for DePIN Orchestration

ms.promise:
DID Generation:
All entities within the NuNet network — organizations, users, and machines — can securely and independently generate their own decentralized identifiers (DIDs) derived from Cardano wallets.
Standards Compliance:
The generated DIDs conform to W3C DID standards, ensuring reliable and standardized identification within Nunet.
ms.criteria:
The code for deriving DIDs from Cardano wallets feature is implemented in the Nunet codebase. It should be passing
・unit tests, 
・integration tests and 
・acceptance tests which represent typical user perspective for the feature

The feature is clearly documented in English outlining the DID generation process and basic usage guidelines. The complete codebase and documentation are publicly available in the Nunet GitLab repository at https://gitlab.com/nunet.
The feature is merged into the main branch and included in a minor or major protocol release.
ms.report:
Output
Cardano Eternl Wallet Integration within the Nunet Protocol. The following functionality has been added with this integration:
・Entities within the NuNet network can generate their own W3C compliant decentralized identifiers (DIDs) using their Eternl wallet. 
・Eternl Wallet can be used to generate capabilities
・Eternl Wallet can be used to grant capabilities to other peers in the network

Note: NuNet's network communication is powered by the NuActor System, a zero-trust system that utilizes fine-grained capabilities, anchored on DIDs, following the UCAN model. With this milestone we allow Cardano Eternl Wallet to be used for identity management, authorisation and authentication necessary for secure interaction within the Nunet network.

ms.report:
Output
Integration of did:prism method within the Nunet Protocol. 
PRISM is a DID method that runs on the Cardano blockchain, providing decentralized identity management. The following functionality has been added with this integration:
・Create and manage PRISM identities
・Sign UCAN tokens with PRISM DIDs
・Verify UCAN tokens signed by PRISM identities
・Interoperate between did:prism and did:key identities

This establishes compatibility with Hyperledger Identus SSI solution which uses the did:prism method
Note: NuNet's network communication is powered by the NuActor System, a zero-trust system that utilizes fine-grained capabilities, anchored on DIDs, following the UCAN model. With this milestone we allow did:prism method to be used for identity management, authorisation and authentication necessary for secure interaction within the Nunet network.

ms.report:
Output
Completed implementation of NeoPrism node integration with NuNet protocol and a POC implementation that validates interoperability between Hyperledger Identus SDK and NuNet Device Management Service (DMS). This demonstrates technical feasibility and integration design for using Hyperledger Identus based identities within the NuNet ecosystem.
A summary report has been created on a public Gitlab issue to document all the relevant work that has been done. This includes:
・Analysis of Hyperledger Identus SSI solution which uses the did:prism method for identity generation and Cardano as its verifiable data registry (VDR).
・Internal discussions and approaches considered for the integration
・Reference to foundational work done towards integration with NeoPrism node used by Hyperledger Identus. 
・Reference to POC implementation that establishes technical feasibility and integration design 

Note: Device Management Service (DMS) is the core component of NuNet protocol. To learn more, please look at our documentation.
